singleResponseCoverage.response: I recommend comparing slow watering and faster watering. The lesson connects infiltration and runoff: if water arrives faster than it soaks in, more may run off. Slow watering takes more time. No local trial has happened; this remains an assumption about our soil. Keep the comparison as the next step because local conditions are unknown. The same idea could help choose drainage approaches for a sports field.

followups.message: Explain how a lesson idea supports or challenges your response.
Describe what you checked, or say what remains untested. A plan alone is not a result.
Explain what you will keep or revise after checking, and why.
Name another situation where this lesson idea could help.
